scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Apprentice Warden Life Aura integration. All earlier frozen references remain unmodified.
game_version: The immutable upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. Supercell's June 2023 launch table provides all currently applicable Apprentice Warden levels but does not identify a current client build.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: The launch note identifies a 7-tile Life Aura affecting nearby ground troops, states that overlapping auras do not stack and that the strongest applies, and publishes L1-L4 HP increase values. It does not specify sub-tile entry timing, removal damage semantics, exact self-targeting, summoned-unit treatment, or a current client build.

aura_range_tiles.note: The official launch note publishes the Life Aura radius.

support.note: Core deterministically applies the strongest nearby attacker Life Aura to eligible ground troops and exposes the resulting HP through existing shared Core, Viewer and RL observations.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only ordinary attack with no Life Aura behavior.
changed_values.replacement: All L1-L4 Life Aura HP increases and 7-tile radius are imported. Core evaluates the strongest nearby attacker aura for each ground troop on every logical tick.
changed_values.justification: The official launch table provides the radius, all four level values and strongest-only overlap contract. The historical payload remains intact and receives only this dated additive behavior record.

known_uncertainties: Supercell does not publish sub-tile aura entry timing, removal damage semantics, exact self-targeting, summoned-unit treatment, or client ordering for this mechanic.

Core applies the published maximum-HP percentage on fixed ticks, grants the newly available HP when a higher aura begins, and caps current HP when it ends. This deterministic health-transition policy is an explicit implementation assumption, not a published client-level timing contract.
The Viewer exposes the resulting Core HP bar but has no separately source-verified Life Aura ring or animation.
conclusion: Apprentice Warden is executable through shared Core, CLI, Viewer and RL paths with a primary-sourced ground Life Aura. It remains partial until transition timing and visual contracts are documented for a versioned client.
